select d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, /**交易编号**/
acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID as prodId, acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME as prodAbbr, d.finprod_type as finprodTypeCode,/**拆借方向Code - 产品类型**/ d.finprod_type as finprodType,/**拆借方向 - 产品类型**/ ftp.TERM_TYPE as termTypeLend,/** 期限品种**/ d.COUNTER_ID as counterId,/**交易对手**/
DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') as tradeDate,/**发生日 - 取交易日期**/ DATE_FORMAT(d.settle_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as settleDate,/*交割日*/ DATE_FORMAT(d.vdate,'%Y-%m-%d') as vDate,/**起息日**/ DATE_FORMAT(d.mdate,'%Y-%m-%d') as mDate,/*到期日*/ ftp.basis as basis,/** 计息基础 **/ d.TRADER as trader,/**交易员**/ ftp.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE as capiIncomeFeature, /** 本金收益特征 **/ d.PRIN_AMT as prinAmt, /** 拆借金额 - 交易本金**/ ftp.INT_RATE*100 as intRate, /** 拆借利率(%) - 固定利率**/ d.INT_AMT as intAmt, /** 应计利息 - 利息总额 **/ ftp.M_TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, /** 到期本息和 - 交易金额**/ v.myAcctName as myAcctName, /**出/收款账户 - 本方资金账户**/ v.counterAcctName as counterAcctName,/**对手方资金账户 **/ '' as 备注 /**备注**/ from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
inner join BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal on deal.BUSI_NO = d.TRADE_ID inner join BOK_BOOKSET book on deal.BOOKSET_ID = book.BOOKSET_ID inner join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO acct on acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = book.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09'
left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO cust_out on cust_out.customer_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_PRODUCT cust_in on cust_in.finprod_id = d.counter_id left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp on ftp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id and ftp.finprod_type = d.finprod_type AND d.BRANCH=ftp.BRANCH left join ( select vo.trade_id , voi1.ACCT_NAME as myAcctName, voi2.ACCT_NAME as counterAcctName from stl_ORDERS vo inner join Stl_Orders_Ext stl_ext on vo.order_id=stl_ext.order_id and stl_ext.is_trade='Y' left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO voi1 on voi1.acct_no = vo.my_acct_no left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO voi2 on voi2.acct_no = vo.counter_acct_no ) v on v.trade_id = d.trade_id where d.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} and acct.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId}
